items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: And then I spent a band we struck that was Joe Oliver, myself, Paul Baldwin, Louis Russell, Bud Scott, our, our, our, Donnell Howard, Albert Nicholas, and our, Bonnie.

ctx.x: Can you tell a bit more about that band? There's some other New Orleans fellows in there too, I believe the clarinetists.
Well now, you see when he first started man, he sent the walls and got Albert Nicholas. Well now when he first started Lincoln Garden we had Buster Bailey and Rudy Jackson. Oh yeah.
Sax, they played bass or baritone sax? No, no, Charlie Jackson.
